title: History screen: add meaningful empty state when no completed runs exist
goal: The History & Comparison screen (screen-history) shows an empty layout when no completed runs exist. The screen-copy says 'Compare runs, review findings delta, and track posture change over time.' but there is nothing to compare. Add an empty state inside the history content area: (1) a one-sentence explanation of what History shows: 'Completed runs appear here — run your first assessment to start building history.', (2) a secondary action button 'Go to Mission Control' to help operators navigate. Additionally: if only ONE run exists (not two needed for comparison), show the single run's summary but disable the comparison controls with a tooltip: 'Complete a second run to compare posture changes.'
scope: System review 2026-05-01: History screen shows an essentially blank view for new installs or single-run engagements. No guidance is provided on why the screen is empty or how to populate it. The comparison controls (comparisonSummary, historyTrend, nextStepsQueue) render empty containers with no empty-state messaging.
